subject: Cobalt AI marketplace syndication & SellWith intake
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@cobalt.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Intro - Cobalt AI marketplace syndication + SellWith interest

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — I’m Sarah (Head of Partnerships) at Cobalt AI. We’re launching a managed inference product for observability teams and evaluating listing across AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces. We’d like to explore Redwood’s syndication + SellWith co-sell program (particularly private offer eligibility and metering).

Quick context: we expect sustained monthly usage in the 25k–60k token-equivalent range across pilot customers, and a few enterprise prospects are asking about private offers and reseller billing. Our CTO has SOC 2 Type II in progress (report due Q1 2028) — we have a security overview attached.

Can you point me to the intake evidence you need, and if possible share a rough timeline for listing + co-sell enablement? Also attaching our SKU mapping spreadsheet so engineering & partner ops can review.

Attachments: Cobalt_Security_Overview.pdf (summary), Cobalt_Product-SKU.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m call this week.

— Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, Cobalt AI
sarah@cobalt.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@cobalt.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 12:05 PM PST
Subject: Re: Intro - Cobalt AI marketplace syndication + SellWith interest

Hi Sarah — great to meet you and congrats on the product launch.

Thanks for the attachments — got them and I’ll circulate internally. High-level next steps from our side:
- Intake review (security + SKU mapping) -> partner-ops + tech validation (2–3 business days)
- Marketplace evidence checklist & private offer eligibility review (we’ll confirm within 5 business days)
- Joint timeline: if all evidence is in place, typical listing + co-sell enablement is ~4–6 weeks.

Can we schedule a 30m intro call tomorrow or Wednesday? Here’s my calendar: https://cal.com/marissa-cole/30?ref=cobalt

Looping in Ben (partner ops) for commercial & SKU routing, Karthik for technical evidence, and Vivek for co-sell uplift & GTM. Ben/Karthik/Vivek — please review the two attachments and come back with immediate gaps.

Talk soon,
— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 3:18 PM PST
Subject: Re: Intro - Cobalt AI marketplace syndication + SellWith interest

Marissa / team — I reviewed the SKU sheet and security summary. Quick checklist to prep before we reply to Sarah with a proposed timeline:

Technical/evidence (owner: Karthik)
- Confirm SOC2 in-progress timeline + evidence we can accept in interim (Sys controls summary, penetration testing results)
- Confirm whether product will use direct marketplace metering or bring-your-own-metering (important for billing flow)
- Any network/VPC integration notes for private deployments

Commercial/ops (owner: Ben)
- Map SKUs to marketplace consumable SKUs (metering dimensions) — see attached sample mapping we use
- Assess private offer eligibility (customer credit terms + volume thresholds)
- Draft mutual action plan and handoff to sales for co-sell leads

GTM/partner (owner: Vivek)
- Ask Vivek to confirm co-sell uplift package (joint marketing, enablement materials, pilot credits)
- Identify 2–3 internal champions from Redwood for the pilot

Timing: if Karthik can confirm the metering approach and SOC2 status by Wednesday EOD, I can assemble a draft intake and proposed 6-week timeline to share with Cobalt on Thursday.

I’ll attach the SKU mapping template in my reply; Karthik please confirm what additional artifacts you need.

— Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, Nov 2, 2027 at 10:09 AM PST
Subject: Re: Intro - Cobalt AI marketplace syndication + SellWith interest

Ben / Marissa — quick tech read:
- SOC2 Type II in progress is fine; interim artifacts we can accept for listing: SOC2 bridge letter, recent pen test report, and a short data-flow diagram. Ask Cobalt to drop those in the shared drive.
- SKU file: looks like they’ve got usage-based SKUs but we need explicit metering dimension names (tokens, inference-requests, model-hours). I’ve annotated the Excel with required column names — will upload to the Drive link.
- For private offers: need to know whether they want marketplace-native private offer (recommended) vs reseller-managed billing. If marketplace-native, we’ll need customer billing accounts and expected commitment windows.

I’ll upload the annotated SKU template + checklist to https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/CobaltAI-intake by EOD. Vivek — I marked a couple of GTM tech notes for co-sell enablement.

— Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@cobalt.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, Nov 4, 2027 at 4:30 PM PST
Subject: Re: Intro - Cobalt AI marketplace syndication + SellWith interest

Hi Sarah — quick recap and next steps after our internal review:

1) Evidence we need from Cobalt (please upload to the Drive link):
   - SOC2 bridge letter + expected Type II delivery date (you noted Q1 2028)
   - Recent penetration test summary or third-party security attestation
   - Annotated SKU mapping (Karthik added required columns; we uploaded a template)

2) Metering & private offers:
   - Confirm desired metering dimension (tokens preferred) and whether you want marketplace-native private offers or reseller/POs. If marketplace-native, share expected customer billing accounts for the first pilot customers.

3) Timeline & next touch:
   - If we receive the items above by COB Monday (Nov 8), we’ll provide a draft intake + proposed listing timeline by Nov 11 and target a 4–6 week cadence from submission to listing depending on marketplace queueing.

4) Meeting: booked a 30m slot next Wednesday to walk through intake and evidence: https://cal.com/marissa-cole/30?ref=cobalt

Attachments / links: Drive intake folder (https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/CobaltAI-intake), draft intake checklist (internal).

Let me know if you need anything else — looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
